title: Safeguarded version orchestrator for private control plane upgrades
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: implement a conservative, observable, and reversible control-plane version orchestration pipeline for Private (VPC) deployments. This ticket scopes the orchestration glue, Terraform/IaC validators, and runtime health gates for automated canary promotions across tenant cohorts. The solution must be usable by both Redwood-managed and customer-managed Private control planes and integrate with existing terraform modules and the controlplane operator. Key principles: non-disruptive dry runs, shadow promotion, tenant fencing, telemetry-driven gating, explicit manual approvals for high-risk tenants, and robust rollback/playbook artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module accepts a target_controlplane_version variable and runs a dry-run plan that fails on drift > allowed thresholds
Orchestrator can promote a staged cohort (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) automatically based on configurable metrics
Health gates evaluate p95 latency, API error rate, reconciler sync latency, and pod restart rate; thresholds are configurable per-release
Shadow promotion mode can mirror control-plane traffic without affecting active routing, allowing real request validation
Automated rollback triggers and manual abort actions are wired into the CI/CD pipeline and Console rollout UI
Runbook and post-mortem checklist created and linked from the ticket
E2E test harness validates orchestrator behavior against a synthetic tenant workload in staging
tasks: Design orchestrator state machine and cohort progression rules
Extend terraform-controlplane module with version metadata and preflight validators
Implement a dry-run terraform plan mode that compares compute/resource diffs and flags incompatible changes
Add shadow-promotion traffic hook into controlplane operator for mirrored validation
Create telemetry gating service that evaluates metrics and exposes approvals via API
Wire orchestrator into existing deploy pipeline (ci/deploy/upgrades) and Console rollout UI
Author upgrade runbook and rollback playbook; add to on-call rotation docs
Create integration tests and synthetic tenant runner in staging
comments: 2025-02-10 - Ava Chen: Created ticket. High-level design drafted in Confluence link above. Proposing cohort sizes 1/5/25/100 for initial plan. Need infra sign-off for terraform dry-run behavior.

2025-02-12 - Ravi Patel: Spiked on terraform dry-run. There are challenges detecting semantic changes (CRD schema changes) vs resource replacements. Plan: add a preflight validator that runs 'kubectl diff' against a canary namespace and fails if top-level API remappings are detected. Opening PR in infra repo.

2025-02-13 - Marta López (SRE): Suggest adding reconciler-sync-lag as a gate; during previous upgrades we saw latent reconciliation lead to burst errors. Also recommend a warmup period for KV cache and an explicit metric to track cache-hit-rate before advancing cohort.

2025-02-14 - Eleanor Kim (PM): Confirmed manual approval step for cohorts >=25% is required for enterprise tenants. Added to acceptance criteria. We should also record audit events to the customer audit log when tenant-level promotions happen.

2025-02-16 - Ravi Patel: Implementation note: using 'upgrade-orchestrator' K8s Job + ConfigMap state machine. Orchestrator will call Terraform Cloud's run API for each tenant cohort; using run triggers to enforce plan/apply separation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234 includes preliminary code for cohort progression and gating checks.

2025-02-17 - Ava Chen: Ran staging smoke test with synthetic tenant (1000 req/min). Shadow promotion validated request handling and no side-effects observed. Observability dashboard updated with gating panels. Minor telemetry lag observed; increased gating window from 2m -> 5m for p95 evaluation.

2025-02-18 - Ravi Patel: Security review requested (KMS access for control plane image sigs). Filing SSO/KMS review separately. Next steps: finalize rollback playbook, add integration tests, and schedule pilot upgrade for internal tenants on 2025-03-01.
